currency_note.value: DATA QUALITY FINDING: Yahoo's fetched price_to_sales (49.3x) and price_to_book (110.9x) for ABB.ST are implausible for an industrial with 40% gross margin and 33% ROE. market_cap/price appear correctly denominated in SEK (the Nasdaq Stockholm cross-listing quote), but total_revenue/equity_book/ebitda/cash/debt/FCF appear to still be ABB's USD-reported primary-listing figures, undivided by the ~9.475 SEK/USD rate - the same currency-mismatch pattern this system has already caught once (Investor AB's margin artifact, CLAUDE.md). FX-corrected estimates (price_to_sales_fx_corrected_est ~5.2x, price_to_book_fx_corrected_est ~11.7x) are far more plausible and are what this review actually used for the Valuation score. Margin/ROE/ROA/debt-to-equity fields are unaffected (same-currency ratios, numerator and denominator share whatever base currency the filing uses) and were used as-is.
